newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tien Wah Press opens S$83 mln print facility.
newsitem.headline: Tien Wah Press opens S$83 mln print facility.

text.p: Tien Wah Press Pte Ltd, South-East Asia's largest sheet-fed printing press, opened a Singapore $83 million printing facility here on Thursday.
The facility was expected to produce 50 million impressions per month, the company said in a statement.
Tien Wah, which also has plants in Malaysia and Indonesia, projected its group turnover from the three facilities at S$150 million.
Tien Wah Press is 85 percent owned by Dai Nippon Printing and 15 percent by Mitsubishi Corp.
